title: English Fell From 75% To 45% As The Internet Globalized
hook: English fell to 45% when the rest of the world logged on.
closing: Searching only in English now leaves nearly half the web—and its voices—unseen.
question: Which language do you browse in?

segments.say: By 2005, English had fallen to 45 percent of web pages. The internet was no longer an English-only room.
Arabic content grew nearly nine times faster than English. New users were rebuilding the web in their own languages.
English still leads at 55 percent of websites. That means nearly half the web now speaks something else.
